name: Jászszentlászló (Hungary)
description: A vertical medium blue banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Jászszentlászló: a blue shield with a white and red figure of Saint Ladislaus and a bird, within a green wreath, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jászszentlászló arms with wreath and scroll
